sections.title: AIMST University Information
sections.content:
The Asian Institute of Medicine, Science and Technology University
(AIMST University) was founded on 15 March 2001. AIMST University is
located in the northern Malaysian state of Kedah Darul Aman on a 230 --
acre site at Gunung Jerai. Self-contained and equipped with
state-of-the-art teaching and laboratory facilities, the campus has
purpose-built student and staff apartments, an Olympic size swimming
pool, an indoor sports hall, Outdoor Sports Pavilion with track and
field, and an Experimental Theatre.
The University firmly believes that high-quality teaching and research
are inextricably bound together and that this ethos should underpin all
its under- and post-graduate courses. Foundation Studies (Science &
Business)

sections.title: About Asia Metropolitan University (AMU)
sections.content:
**Asia Metropolitan University (AMU) is a private university in Malaysia
that was established in 2004. Previously known as Masterskill University
College of Health Sciences, the university prides itself on its Nursing,
Medicine, and Health Sciences programs. It also offers Business,
Accounting, Information Technology, and Computer Science programs.**
**In line with the recent developments in the industry and within the
institution, AMU is focused on producing trained, qualified, competent
graduates for domestic and international markets in health sciences and
various other disciplines. AMU aims to be "The University of Choice"
within the local and global education landscape.**
**The university has two campuses --- one in Cyberjaya, which hosts its
Business, Accounting, Information Technology, and Computer Science
programs, and another in Johor Bahru, which hosts its Medicine and
Healthcare-related programs.**
**ASIA Metropolitan University (AMU) has over a decade of experience in
developing high-quality education in various realms of knowledge.
Anchored by this, AMU has produced a total of 25,380 graduates since it
was established in 2004.**

sections.title: Asia Pacific University (APU) Malaysia
sections.content:
Asia Pacific University in Malaysia is known as the Asia Pacific
University of Technology and Innovation. APU is the colloquial name of
the Asia Pacific University of Technology and Innovation or Asia Pacific
University in Malaysia. APU has become one of Malaysia's leading private
universities for engineering, technology, information, and business
programs.
At first, it was established as the Asia Pacific Institute of
Information Technology (APIIT) name in 1993. 2004 the name was finally
changed to the Asia Pacific University College of Technology and
Innovation. It has opened its foreign campuses in Pakistan, Sri Lanka,
and India.
APU has produced more than 50,000 qualified graduates. Asia Pacific
University in Malaysia has managed to maintain 5-STAR (EXCELLENT Rating)
under the SETARA 2017. APU has become one of the top private
universities in Malaysia for international students.

sections.title: History

Founded in 1991 by Raja Singham, BAC began as a small college offering
courses in law. Over the years, it has expanded significantly, both in
terms of its physical infrastructure and the range of programs offered.
The college has grown to include a comprehensive suite of courses in
law, business, and other professional disciplines.

innovative teaching methods. It offers a wide range of programs, from
pre-university to postgraduate levels, including the University of
London International Programmes, UK Transfer Degree Programmes, and
professional qualifications such as the CLP (Certificate in Legal

students with an optimal learning environment. These include modern
classrooms, extensive libraries, computer labs, and dedicated study
areas. BAC also provides access to a variety of online resources and
learning platforms, ensuring students have the tools they need to
succeed.

college offers various services, including academic counseling, career
guidance, and internship placements. Additionally, BAC hosts numerous
extracurricular activities and clubs, fostering a well-rounded
educational experience.

sections.title: Global Partnerships and Collaborations

institutions around the world. These collaborations provide students
with opportunities for international exposure and access to global
educational resources. Through its transfer programs, students can
complete their degrees at prestigious institutions in the UK, Australia,
and other countries.

sections.title: Achievements and Recognition

Over the years, BAC has garnered numerous accolades and recognitions. It
is known for producing top-performing students who excel academically
and professionally. The college's commitment to quality education has
earned it a strong local and international reputation.

initiatives. The college runs various programs to give back to society
and support underprivileged communities. These initiatives reflect BAC's
dedication to making a positive impact beyond the classroom.

internationally, KTAC aims to develop qualified individuals in the
domains of commerce, accountancy, IT, law, education, food & beverage,
halal, and aviation. Since its founding, our university has produced
more than 30,000 qualified graduates, and it currently enrolls up to
4,000 students.**
**In addition to developing and providing regional academic programs,
KTAC offers students opportunities through partnerships with colleges
like Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM). We have partnered with several
organizations to share and transfer information about technology,
techniques, concepts, and software.**
**The academic institution Kolej Cybernetics International College fees
and this college provides qualified high school graduates with the
chance to pursue accredited degrees in a range of industries of their
choosing. Our primary goal is to satisfy the needs of students who want
comprehensive and reasonable eligibility so they may start working as
soon as feasible. Our academic curriculum mixes lectures and hands-on
activities to guarantee that we produce graduates with a high level of
proficiency. Employability, reliability, and problem-solving skills are
the primary traits we prioritize for development.**
**As a result, they place a high priority on pertinent industries since
we want our students to find employment once they graduate. Industry
experts are frequently invited to interact with our faculty members and
explain the kinds of talents they are seeking. Lastly, as part of the
coursework, all required students are sent on a six-month training
program to expose them to practical experience in their respective
professions, giving our students a competitive edge. Our connections
with major corporations in the industry have grown over time, which
helps our graduates find work quickly.**

sections.title: GU Program List, Online Offered Program List
sections.content:
Geomatika University (GU) is the cheapest private university in
Malaysia, offering foundation, undergraduate, and postgraduate programs
for national and international students at a low cost. It offers
approximately 38 courses for part-time & full-time students. These
courses are allocated for both national and international students.
Geomatika University has earned massive popularity for offering programs
at low tuition fees and maintaining effective communication and friendly
relationships with students. It has become one of the most famous
universities in Malaysia for providing programs at a low cost in 2020.
In addition, they offer scholarships for both national and international
students. Geomatika University has established its Department of
Geospatial and Land Development. This department launches the Centre of
GIS (CeGIS) Short Courses Program in Geospatial Technology and the
Certificate in Land Assistantship Surveying. Geomatika offers programs
in land survey, GIS, property & valuation, architecture, pharmacy,
medical Assistant, and many more.

sections.title: DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR APPLICATION & VISA PROCESSING
sections.content:
Complete the UGM Application Form. EMGS and Application Fees of RM
4,750. Cheque/ bank draft should be made payable to GEO GLOBAL.
MANAGEMENT SDN BHD, non-refundable (inclusive EMGS registration fee for
i-Kad) -- Certified true copies of academic results relevant to the
entry requirements of the applied program. -- Proof of English Language
proficiency, e.g, IELTS or TOEFL if any. -- 6 photographs with white
background, size 3.5 cm x 5 cm- 2 sets of passport copies, including
blank pages. -- Please take note that Pre-Health Medical screening
results conducted in the home country must be submitted along with a
complete UGM Application Form. Applications from SUDAN and NIGERIA are
required to provide N.O.C. (No Objection Certificate). Applications from
IRAN are required to provide L.O.E. (Letter of Eligibility)

sections.content:

is made in the student's home country, then payment must be in the form
of telegraphic (TT) only. Students who do not hold the minimum English
requirements in IELTS, TOEFL, CPE, CAE & PTE are required to re-sit OR
take our EPP after arrival in Malaysia with a duration of 6 months. The
EPP is a preparatory class before the students re-sit for one of the
tests mentioned until meet the required score for the program applied.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Founded in 1970 by the Malaysian Advertisers Association (MAA) and the
Association of Accredited Advertising Agents Malaysia (4As), IACT
College was established to meet the growing demand for skilled
professionals in the advertising and communication industries. Over the
decades, it has evolved into a leading educational institution dedicated
to nurturing creative talent.

sections.title: University Address
sections.content: VSQ@PJ City Centre, Jalan Utara, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: Private College

sections.title: Educational Excellence
sections.content:
IACT College offers a wide range of programs at the certificate,
diploma, and degree levels, focusing on areas such as advertising,
graphic design, mass communication, and marketing. The college's
curriculum is designed to blend theoretical knowledge with practical
skills, ensuring that students are well-prepared for the dynamic and
ever-changing creative industries.

sections.title: Facilities and Resources
sections.content:
IACT College is equipped with modern facilities to enhance the learning
experience. These include state-of-the-art design studios, media labs,
and production facilities. The college also provides access to
industry-standard software and tools, enabling students to work on
real-world projects and assignments.

sections.title: Industry Connections and Practical Training
sections.content:
One of the key strengths of IACT College is its strong industry
connections. The college collaborates closely with industry
professionals and organizations, offering students opportunities for
internships, industry projects, and networking. This practical approach
ensures that students gain hands-on experience and insights into the
creative industries.

sections.title: Achievements and Recognition
sections.content:
IACT College has a track record of producing award-winning students who
have excelled in various competitions and industry events. The college's
emphasis on creativity, innovation, and practical skills has earned it
recognition as a leading institution for creative communication
education.

sections.title: Student Support and Development
sections.content:
IACT College is committed to providing comprehensive support to its
students. This includes academic counseling, career guidance, and
various extracurricular activities. The college also hosts workshops,
seminars, and guest lectures by industry experts, providing students
with valuable learning experiences beyond the classroom.

sections.title: Community Engagement and Social Responsibility
sections.content:
IACT College encourages students to engage in community service and
social responsibility initiatives. Through various programs and
projects, students can apply their creative skills to benefit society
and contribute to positive social change.

IIMAT is one of the recognised cheapest colleges in Malaysia for

location; IIMAT is in Malaysia's capital. The college specialises in the
education of multimedia design. The college conduct programs to make a

knowledge on individual courses, and create affordable education
possibilities.

college. All of the programs offered by the college, including
Hospitality, Social science, and Economics, Science and Technology are
internationally recognised. But the institution has collaborations with
international universities for several degree programs. The college
offer internationally recognised programs from different areas of
science. They offer a wide range of programs, including science and
technology, social science, hospitality, and economics.

university is dedicated to building a better future for students with
expertise, skills, and knowledge. Students work in various fields of the
corporate and academic sectors. At Infrastructure University, students
get a chance to learn skills and hands-on expertise.

create opportunities for students to learn in the workplace better. The

and produce expert graduates. The university also offers language

sections.content:
IUKL is the only comprehensive infrastructure university in Malaysia.
The university has received five stars in the latest 2022 QS rating
system for its excellent teaching and academic facilities. High
practitioners take classes at this university, one of the best
universities in Malaysia for engineering students. Let's Look at Why
IUKL is the Best University in Malaysia. Firstly, Infrastructure
University provides full support for international students, including
admission, visa application, and job opportunities. IUKL has a student
management centre where trained immigration advisors work to deliver
information regarding their student visas in Malaysia. Besides, the
university offers excellent opportunities for international students,
including accommodation placement. Additionally, IUKL has many clubs and
alumni associations where students. Students can also join music,
debate, culture, and sports clubs. Moreover, IUKL offers the best
opportunities for internship students. This university assists students
in finding a multinational company to complete their industrial training
program. The university works closely with its industrial partners to
prepare graduates to beat the corporate world. A career placement unit
in the university creates employment opportunities for the students to
assist them. Infrastructure University Kuala Lumpur (IUKL) offers loans
for local students and waivers for international students. Students can
enjoy loans from the Perbadanan Tabung Pendidikan Tinggi National.
Students can have opportunities for other financial loans and
scholarships based on the result. IUKL provides both on-campus and

with 24 hours security. The students have a cafeteria, clinic, pool, and
transport facility. Finally, Infrastructure University Kuala Lumpur

futuristic development.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
**\
IMU University Overview**
IMU University refers to the International Medical University (IMU) is
located in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur. It is Malaysia's first and sole
private university dedicated to medical and health sciences. Since 1992,
IMU University has developed a worldwide reputation as a world-class
center for healthcare education, clinical research, and healthcare
innovation. With a relentless focus on creating highly skilled and
empathetic healthcare practitioners, IMU combines intellectual intensity
with clinical experiential work.
The university offers a wide selection of degree programs in disciplines
like Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Biomedical Science,
Psychology, Nutrition, Chiropractic, and Health Informatics, among many
others. A unique feature of the International Medical University (IMU)
is its Partner University Program (PUP), whereby students are allowed to
begin their studies in Malaysia and then complete their studies at
distinguished partner universities in the United Kingdom, Australia,
Canada, and New Zealand.
The contemporary IMU campus offers a vibrant educational environment
augmented by up-to-date laboratories, simulated centers, and clinical
campuses throughout Malaysia. Driven by its mission to be a pioneer of
world-class excellence in learning and scholarship, IMU steadfastly
leads the way in advancing the future direction of healthcare education
in Asia and around the world.

Why Study at Universiti Malaya Wales in Malaysia?
Dual Degree: With UM-Wales' Dual Award programs, you may earn a UK
degree in Malaysia without having to pay the exorbitant fees associated
with studying in the UK. Our partner university, the University of Wales
Trinity Saint David (UWTSD), in the United Kingdom, collaborates with us
to offer our Dual Award programs. You will be certified by both UWTSD
and UM-Wales upon graduation.
Student Mobility: Our partner university, the University of Wales
Trinity Saint David (UWTSD), in Wales, in the United Kingdom, offers
Dual Award students the chance to study there. Year 2 is often when the
study abroad time occurs. The cost of the mobility program is RM 21,000.
One of UWTSD's picturesque campuses in Swansea is where you will study;
the campus you are assigned to will depend on your program.
Study Visit:
All students are eligible to participate in UM-Wales' short-term visit
to the UK. Students will learn about various cultures, hone their
language abilities, and expand their social and professional horizons in
addition to seeing some of the most well-known sites in the UK.
All UM-Wales students, dual award or not, have the ideal chance to visit
Wales and take advantage of the university's connections with both Wales
and the UK through the Study Visit. This trip will provide you with the
opportunity to learn more about Welsh and British culture, study abroad
for a short time, and make lifelong memories while having some amazing
experiences!
International Recognition: Although leaving home for your studies abroad
can be difficult, it's a crucial choice that will affect your future. In
addition to receiving a top-notch education, attending UM-Wales will
expose you to a wide variety of social and cultural events that will aid
in the development of your personal and professional traits. We will do
everything in our power to make sure that your time here as a student
will help you realize your full potential and get you ready for the
working world.

sections.title: The Campus of INTI International University
sections.content:
INTI International University and Colleges is one of the top QS-ranked
universities in Malaysia. The world-class campuses are equipped with the
technologies and the art facilities to create an environment for the
students, offering a cultural learning experience. INTI International
College was founded in 1986. However, on 31 May 2010, the Higher
Education Ministry in Malaysia upgraded to university status. Since
2010, INTI University has operated its activities as a university.

sections.title: Why is INTI the Best University in Malaysia?
sections.content:
It's been more than 30 years since INTI University has produced more
than 55000 young graduates with quality education. In the education
sector of Malaysia, INTI University has become a trusted name for
students and researchers. It has been the best private university in
Malaysia for its teaching methods, management tools, international
faculty, and global resources. The variety of programs at INTI
University creates many opportunities for students in the professional
sector. It also provides high-quality and student-friendly lectures. It
ranked among the top 20 private universities in Malaysia in 2024 for
international students.
Additionally, a student from diverse and various cultures creates an
academic environment. Therefore, the educational atmosphere of this
university offers exciting learning opportunities for international
students. INTI International University and Colleges have collaborated
with the top-ranked global universities. Besides, INTI provides
extracurricular activities for the students. It has collaborated with
over 450 industry-leading partners like IBM, Google, Mercedes-Benz, and
Huawei.
Finally, INTI University offers a credit transfer program, allowing
students to transfer to the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and European
countries to complete their degree. Usually, students need to complete
one year here in Malaysia and another 2-3 years in other countries. It
is a reputed university that offers business programs including a
Bachelor of Business (Hons) in Marketing, International Business, Human
Resource Management, and Business Administration. Veteran lecturers and
scholars educate students with both theoretical and practical knowledge.
Students learn about business models, quality management, and business
plans for entrepreneurs. INTI University produces a good number of
entrepreneurs every year.

sections.title: INTI Credit Transfer Program (UK, Australia, USA, Canada & France)
sections.content:
INTI is one of the best private Universities in Malaysia and offers
top-notch education to our international students from nearly 100
different countries. Our collaboration with highly acclaimed
universities from the UK, Australia, USA, Canada & France enables
students to gain an added edge in qualification while expanding their
global perspectives.
INTI offers excellent value to our students and remarkably lucrative
deals for our agents. Please see below for some of the reasons to
partner with INTI:
- INTI's most popular program is the American Degree Transfer Program
 2+2 or the Australian Degree Transfer Program. Students enjoy two
 years of studies in Malaysia and continue their two years in the
 USA/Canada/Australia. INTI has more than 300 partner Universities in
 the USA and Canada, and 15 partner Universities in Australia.
- Offering flexible twinning/transfer study pathways (3+0, 2+1 & 1+2)
 with our partnership with Sheffield Hallam University (UK),
 University of Hertfordshire (UK), Coventry University (UK),
 Swinburne University of Technology (Australia), Southern New
 Hampshire University (America), CY Cergy Paris Université (France).
- FREE Intensive English classes, FREE Foundation (Pre-U) program, and
 FREE Master's program for international students.
- FREE Accommodation\* -- T&Cs Applied.
- Students enjoy an internationally recognized tertiary education with
 affordable tuition fees and living expenses in Malaysia. Our degree
 costs an average of 18,000 USD for the entire 3-year program.
- A professional and well-equipped international student education
 counselor team to provide immediate support.
- POSM such as posters, brochures, course guides, freebies, and other
 marketing collaterals, will be provided.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Karisma International College Fees are the same as those of Ranaco
Education & Training Institute. It was established in 2003 as a Tourism
Training Institute approved by the Malaysian Ministry of Tourism.
Karisma International College is run by Karisma Merdu Sdn. Bhd. It was
founded by several people with a variety of training and program-related
backgrounds, under the direction of Y.M. Ungku Shamsoon N'har Ungku
Omar, the late Professor Dr. Ungku Omar's daughter.
The task of creating the Skills Standards for Employment Services (SKPK)
for the Community-based Adult Care Services Sector has been given to it
by the Department of Skills Development (JPK). Furthermore, a variety of
short-term courses in language and interpersonal skills (soft skills)
are available at Karisma International College.
Among these are the Women's Martial Arts program, Reflexology, Effective
Salesmanship, In-Show Presentation Skills, and the Emotional Excellence
program. In addition to offering training modules for skills improvement
courses like Home Manager, Reflexology, Improved Homestay, and Foreign
Language Skills Course for Tourist Guide, Karisma International College
also serves as an expert in industry socioeconomic studies and
negotiation consultations.

sections.title: Step-by-step Process of Admission
sections.content:
- The student needs to submit the required academic documents for
 evaluation (Academic records, Valid Passport copy, English
 Proficiency certificate).
- After evaluation, the student will receive the Application form and
 Health declaration form (The filled form must be submitted within 24
 hours). Within 48 hours, the student will receive the Eligibility
 letter, in which the student has to confirm the admission by paying
 the admission fee and the 1st-year tuition fee.
- Once the payment is made, we can begin the visa process with EMGS.
- The visa process typically takes four weeks to be issued.
- Visa status can be tracked via EMGS.
- Upon arrival at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you will be
 provided with an airport pick-up by a University Representative (or)
 Hostel Warden.

sections.title: Lincoln University (LU) Malaysia
sections.content:
Lincoln University (LU) is a private university in Petaling Jaya,
Malaysia. It was established in 2002 as Lincoln College (LC); however,
in 2011 it was upgraded to Lincoln University College. LU was elevated
to university in 2022 from a university college. Lincoln University is
one of the excellent private educational institutions approved by the
Ministry of Higher Education and Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA-
National Accreditation Board).
Recently, LUC was crowned with a 5-star ranking by the Ministry of
Higher Education, Malaysia, 2017. In 2019, it also managed to be listed
among the top ten universities in Malaysia as per Times Higher Education
(THE) University Impact Rankings. Additionally, it has been nominated as
an ISO 9001:2015 certified educational institution. Moreover, LUC has
collaborated with the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), the
Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU) in London, and members of
the International Association of Universities (IAU) in Paris.

sections.title: Why Study At Lincoln University (LU) Malaysia?
sections.content:
Firstly, Lincoln University's administrators are very cordial with
students. Secondly, the lecturers assist local and international
students by providing quality education to achieve their independent and
common goals. The prime objective of this institute is to provide
theoretical and practical skills so that students can apply them in
their future careers.

scholarships:
**LSBF Scholarship:** Before receiving a scholarship award, students who
apply are evaluated by a panel using a set of criteria and then
interviewed.
**LSBF Global Excellence Scholarship:** Understudies who score a total
of seven or less for the best six subjects in their 'O' Level/SPM
assessments are qualified to apply for these grant grants. These honors
are accessible at passage level for all confirmation programs undertaken
at LSBF. The grant is identical to the expenses for LSBF courses.
**LSBF Hardship Scholarship Award:** This scholarship is given to
current students who have unexpected financial difficulties because
their parents or guardians are unable to pay for their education because
of unanticipated events like accidents, hospital stays, deaths, or job
loss. The scholarship is solely available for LSBF courses and is for
unpaid balances owed to LSBF.
**LSBF Global CEO's Merit Scholarship:** LSBF students with exceptional
academic accomplishments are eligible to apply for the LSBF Chairman's
Merit Scholarship.

sections.title: LSBF College Malaysia
sections.content:
LSBF College, formerly known as Elite International College (EIC) since
its founding in 1998, is a prestigious private educational institution
located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. In 2024, LSBF Singapore acquired
Elite International College, marking a major milestone in LSBF's global
expansion. The Malaysia Campus showcases LSBF's dedication to providing
high-quality education and nurturing future leaders and innovators
worldwide.
This expansion adds to LSBF's existing campuses in the United Kingdom
and Singapore, enhancing its global network and reaffirming its
commitment to offering excellent educational opportunities worldwide. As
part of Global University Systems (GUS), LSBF has grown since its
founding in 2003, expanding from professional qualifications to offering
a wide range of diploma, foundation, and undergraduate programs in
fields like business, IT, accounting, logistics, hospitality, health
sciences, and the arts. These programs are in partnership with renowned
UK and Australian universities. The LSBF Malaysia campus embodies LSBF's
mission to empower students with the skills and knowledge to succeed
globally.

universities in Malaysia, with an excellent record of providing the best
higher education opportunities. It is also known as MSU Malaysia. MSU
offers diverse courses for local and international students, including
engineering, law, MBBS, nursing, health science, pharmacy, management,
and computer technologies. Students have an opportunity to experience
new opportunities beyond their academic achievements. As a large private
university in Malaysia, MSU Malaysia provides quality education to enjoy
student life and build a dynamic career. It also offers accommodation
facilities fulfilling the needs and requirements of the students.

internal talents.

**\
Mantissa College -- Courses, Tuition Fees & Application Process**
The Article offers information about Mantissa College, campus, location,
rankings, pathways program, Courses, Tuition fees, University partners,
and Application Process
Mantissa College Fees are way more affordable than any other mid-range
university/college. Mantissa College works to develop and bring out the
best in young people. The College provides a range of industry-driven
programs from pre-university to post-graduate level, as well as
professional credentials, in response to the growing need for skilled
professionals in the globalized economy. In addition to teaching
information, the college makes every effort to prepare students for the
workforce in this dynamic, globalized world.
The College now offers a variety of business courses at the
undergraduate and graduate levels after forming collaborations with
various respected universities from across the globe. For additional
study, credits can be transferred to these partner universities in the
US, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. Students can save up to 70% of
their overall expenses and save time by selecting this option.

 Meeting the criteria does not automatically guarantee the applicant
 a scholarship. In addition, you should meet all entry and language

 admission into our programmes, please visit

 successful candidates are eligible to enroll for full-time Master's
 and Ph.D. degree programmes by research only.
8. What are the fees that will be covered for this scholarship? Ans:
 This scholarship covers admission fee, programme fee, student
 development fee, subject fees and thesis examination fee within the
 duration of Scholarship. Re-take subjects are self-financed.
9. What is the duration of this scholarship? Ans: Duration of
 scholarship is limited to two (2) years for Master's and three (3)
 years for Ph.D. programmes respectively. No extension of the
 scholarship will be allowed.

 university? Ans: This scholarship is only open to candidates who
 have received an offer letter but yet to register into the
 university.

 working pass to be eligible.

maritime studies and related disciplines. NMUC is a Dutch-Malaysian
private higher learning institution specializing in maritime education,
training, and consultancy services. Located in Johor, Malaysia, right at
the heart of a bustling maritime region, NMUC is strategically
positioned to support national and regional competitiveness in the
maritime, logistics as well and oil and gas industries through the
offering of various accredited academic and training programs.

sections.title: Key Information
sections.content:
1. Location: NMUC is based in Malaysia, with a strategic focus on the
 maritime industry. It leverages Malaysia's position as a key player
 in global maritime trade routes.
2. Academic Programs: NMUC provides a range of undergraduate and
 postgraduate programs focused on maritime education and training.
 Courses are tailored to equip students with technical skills,
 knowledge of maritime laws, and expertise in shipping, port
 management, and logistics.
3. Specialized Curriculum: NMUC's curriculum emphasizes hands-on
 training in maritime disciplines, management practices in the
 shipping industry, international maritime laws, and logistics
 management.
4. Industry Connections: The institution maintains strong ties with
 industry leaders and maritime organizations, providing students with
 internship opportunities and exposure to real-world practices. This
 ensures that graduates are ready to step into the maritime workforce
 with confidence.
5. State-of-the-Art Facilities: NMUC equip studens with modern teaching
 facilities and simulators to offer practical training experiences
 for maritime students. These facilities are essential for students
 pursuing navigation, shipping management, and marine engineering.

sections.title: Mission and Vision
sections.content:
NMUC aims to be a leading center for maritime education, fostering a new
generation of professionals who are well-equipped to meet the challenges
of the modern maritime industry. The institution is committed to
promoting innovation, sustainability, and excellence in maritime
practices.

sections.title: Industry Connections
sections.content:
NMUC boasts strong ties with the maritime sector, including partnerships
with shipping companies, port authorities, and logistics firms. These
connections enable students to gain invaluable practical experience
through internships, co-op programs, and industry projects, ensuring
they are job-ready upon graduation.

In 2019, the college was rebranded as Newton International College and

The vision of the college is to be a top-notch Higher Education

Holistic Education.

sections.title: Putra Business School UPM
sections.content:
Putra Business School (PBS) is a leading business school in Malaysia
affiliated with Universiti Putra Malaysia. It has managed to achieve
world-class international accreditation by AASCB (Association to Advance
Collegiate Schools of Business). PBS is the acronym of the Putra
Business School. It is located inside the campus of University Putra
Malaysia (UPM). According to a statistical report, only 5% of the
world's business schools have received AACSB accreditation, and PBS is
one of them. Additionally, PBS is accredited by ABEST21 (The Alliance on
Business Education and Scholarship for Tomorrow, a 21st-century Century
Organization). All programs offered by PBS are also endorsed by the
Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) and the Malaysian Ministry of
Higher Education. PBS offers MBA, Masters, and PhD programs for local
and international students.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Managerial Economics** **Course Code: GSM5000
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course covers the application of
economic theory and decision science tools to determine the optimal
solution to the managerial decision problem. The topics that will be
discussed include demand analysis and forecasting, production and costs,
pricing and output decision.
**Name of Course/Module: Organizational Behavior** **Course Code:
GSM5101** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course focuses on the
effects of individual, group, and organizational work on behavior and
performance. It also focuses on the effects of these factors on
organizational effectiveness.
**Name of Course/Module: Operations Management** **Course Code:
GSM5113** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course encompasses
designing products, the production process, acquiring and organizing
necessary resources, and planning/executing production. Issues and
concepts, management of the operation function, organizing and managing
the provision of goods, and recognizing potential areas of improvement
in the management of goods and services are discussed.
**Name of Course/Module: Business Research Methods** **Course Code:
GSM5114** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course focuses on the
analysis of business problems and the use of the scientific approach as
a problem-solving tool. This encompasses problem identifications,
research objectives, development of theoretical frameworks, appropriate
research designs, quantitative versus qualitative approaches,
statistical analysis techniques, report writing, and presentation.
**Name of Course/Module: Case Writing and Analysis** **Course Code:
GSM5116** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course encompasses the
definition of a case, concepts, tools, and processes of case writing,
data requirements and collection, case reports, and analysis.
**Name of Course/Module: Business Law and Ethics** **Course Code:
GSM5131** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers the
conceptual and practical aspects of law and ethics in the business
environment.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Strategic Management** **Course Code: GSM5160
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers four major
components, namely strategic planning, processes, systems, and current
issues that require the application of knowledge on management,
marketing, finance, and operations.
**Name of Course/Module: Management Information Systems** **Course Code:
GSM5170** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course provides a basic
understanding of the roles and uses of information systems and
technology for business operations, management decision-making, and
strategic advantages. The concepts, development, and implementation of
information systems involving management issues of organizations are
discussed.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Marketing Management** **Course Code: GSM5200
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course encompasses an
understanding of the basic concepts, strategies, and theories of
marketing management. These include of marketing environment; consumer
and organization buying behavior; decisions and strategies of the
marketing mixes, such as product, price, distribution, and promotion;
strategic marketing planning, implementation, and control of marketing
programs; and major techniques in gathering information that determines
marketing objectives, and strategies of companies.
**Name of Course/Module: Accounting for Decision Making** **Course Code:
GSM5301** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers the basic
accounting concepts for the recognition of assets, liabilities, revenue,
and expenses in the preparation of financial statements. The use of
financial statements for analysis of performance, cost concepts, and
short-term decision-making techniques, as well as the evaluation of
management control systems, are discussed.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Financial Management** **Course Code: GSM5400
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course covers the basic elements
of financial management, financial analysis, financial forecasting,
financial planning and control time value of money, valuating of
financial assets, risk and return, and capital budgeting. Issues
relating to financial theory and corporate policies will be discussed.
**Name of Course/Module: Human Resource Management** **Course Code:
GSM5500** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course focuses on the
principles, techniques, and processes related to the function of human
resource management; how human resources contribute to the
organization's business strategy and competitive advantage; potential
unethical practices in these functions, and how to control them.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Consumer Behaviour** **Course Code: GSM5230
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** In this course, students will be able
to understand the concepts and tools to develop a comprehensive
understanding of consumer behavior principles, which cover consumers'
activities in acquiring, consuming, and disposing of products.
Understanding consumer behavior has become one of the important elements
of marketing strategy, which enables marketers to understand and predict
consumer behavior to increase the chances of being successful in the
market.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Marketing Research** **Course Code: GSM5210
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course is composed of the basic
theories and procedures used in identifying and solving various
marketing research problems in the context of business organizations and
decision-making. Other marketing research processes will also be
discussed.
**Name of Course/Module: e-Marketing** **Course Code: GSM5271** **Credit
Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course is designed to prepare students
with the knowledge and skills to direct and manage the e-marketing
process by integrating marketing processes and internet technology. The
integration of text and cases will help students gain a better grasp of
e-marketing.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Global Marketing** **Course Code: GSM5281
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course provides an understanding
of globalization and how it affects marketing, while also looking at the
role of marketing in the globalization process. The ultimate purpose of
this course is to help students develop sufficient knowledge to be
effective managers overseeing global marketing activities in an
increasingly competitive environment.
**Name of Course/Module: International Marketing** **Course Code:
GSM5280** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** In this course, students
will analyze the international markets from various dimensions. It also
provides students the opportunity to understand the various
environmental variables that shape the management of international
marketing. This leads to an understanding of important strategies
related to the management of the marketing mix that is required to meet
the demands of true world markets in a dynamic and ever-changing
setting.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Promotion Marketing** **Course Code: GSM5260
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course will investigate the role
of marketing communications in an overall marketing strategy context and
examine the evolving range of communication options now available to
management. The various tasks concerned with managing the marketing
communication functions represent a particular focus of this course.
**Name of Course/Module: Supply Chain Management** **Course Code:
GSM5242** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course teaches students
the strategic importance of good supply chain design, planning, and
operation. Also, students learn how good supply chain management can be
a competitive advantage while weaknesses in the supply chain hurt the
performance of a firm.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Technology Marketing** **Course Code: GSM5270
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course develops customer analysis
as the foundation for all good marketing and includes tools such as
segmentation and marketing research. Topics related to product policy,
pricing, distribution, and promotion of marketing high-technology
products are also discussed.

sections.title: FINANCE
sections.content:
**Name of Course/Module: International Finance** **Course Code:
GSM5480** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course provides
comprehensive coverage of International Finance theories and concepts.
The real-world aspects of International finance are explored through
research papers, case studies, and media reports on current events.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Investment Analysis** **Course Code: GSM5421
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course includes comprehensive
coverage of investment, techniques, concepts, and theories. The
practical aspects of investments, specifically the current investment
practices in the financial markets, are discussed through research
findings reported in journal papers, consultancy reports, and investment
reports, prepared by brokerage and financial institutions.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Corporate Finance** **Course Code: GSM5401
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course encompasses the basic
financial management functions of capital budgeting, capital structure
and working capital management. Emphasis is given to capital budgeting
strategy, basic capital structure theories, working capital, and
liquidity management concepts. Merger and acquisition, and corporate
restructuring are also discussed.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Financial Planning** **Course Code: GSM5461
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers the financial
planning process and offers exposure to areas of personal financial
planning. Process and analysis of information to construct personnel
financial statements and a comprehensive financial plan are discussed.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Islamic Finance** **Course Code: GSM5490
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course examines the Islamic
finance theoretical framework, Islamic financing, and investment
principles in business from the Islamic perspective.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Security Analysis and Portfolio Theory
sections.content:
**Course Code: GSM5422** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course
covers the theoretical aspects of portfolio management as well as
security analysis and its applications. Specifically, topics such as
risk and return, portfolio theory, mean-variance efficiency, use of
single-index model and its application for the formation of the
efficient, Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM), Arbitrage Pricing Theory
(APT), fundamental analysis and valuation techniques, technical
analysis, efficient capital market theory, performance evaluation
methods, and portfolio strategies will be discussed.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Industrial Relations** **Course Code: GSM5540
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course emphasizes management
strategies in handling situations that have arisen from the existence of
trade unions in organizations, beginning with their formation until the
implementation of trade unionism activities. It includes issues of trade
union recognition, collective bargaining agreements, and industrial
disputes.
**Name of Course/Module: Training & Development Management** **Course
Code: GSM5520** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course includes
structural and process considerations in designing training and
development programs at the micro-level and the main methods that may be
adopted to train and develop employees in an organization.
**Name of Course/Module: Communications For Managers** **Course Code:
GSM5103** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers theories
and principles of management communication in organizations, with an
application in everyday managerial interaction.
**Name of Course/Module: Compensation Management** **Course Code:
GSM5530** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers the major
strategic and operational decisions that managers should make in
designing and implementing an organization's pay, benefit, and incentive
programs. It emphasizes the techniques and procedures for conducting job
analysis, job evaluation, and compensation surveys.
**Name of Course/Module: Cross-Cultural Management** **Course Code:
GSM5550** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course covers issues and
problems related to three levels of culture: intra-cultural,
inter-cultural, and cross-cultural. It discusses the meaning of culture,
cultural influences on management, and strategies to address issues
related to conflicts caused by cultural differences.
**Name of Course/Module: Organizational Development** **Course Code:
GSM5521** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course covers the steps
in the organization development process, with emphasis on intervention
design and implementation steps. It examines the major interventions
used in organization development.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: International Business Management And Policy
sections.content:
**Course Code: GSM5181** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course
examines theories related to international business in both
international trade and direct investment. It also covers the complex
environmental factors in the areas of marketing, operations, finance,
and human resources.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: International Trade** **Course Code: GSM5123
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course provides coverage of
market globalization, world trade growth, and the effects of global
trading. It also explains the importance of the neo-classical model of
trade theory. Government trade policy, regional integration, and customs
union are also discussed.
**Name of Course/Module: Cross-Cultural Management** **Course Code:
GSM5550** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course covers issues and
problems related to three levels of culture: intra-cultural,
inter-cultural, and cross-cultural. It discusses the meaning of culture,
cultural influences on management, and strategies to address issues
related to conflicts caused by cultural differences.
**Name of Course/Module: International Finance** **Course Code:
GSM5480** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The course provides
comprehensive coverage of International Finance theories and concepts.
The real-world aspects of International finance are explored through
research papers, case studies, and media reports on current events.
**Name of Course/Module: International Marketing** **Course Code:
GSM5280** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** In this course, students
will be able to analyze international markets from various dimensions.
It also provides students understanding of the various environmental
variables that shape the management of international marketing. This
leads to an understanding of important strategies related to the
management of the marketing mix that is required to meet the demands of
world markets in a dynamic and ever-changing setting.

sections.title: CORPORATE GOVERNANCE
sections.content:
**Name of Course/Module: Corporate Administration** **Course Code:
GSM5118** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** The Chartered Secretary is
regularly employed in a position of strategic responsibility for
administrative operations within and across the organization. The module
aims to instill knowledge and key skills in handling the
responsibilities of corporate administration in both the strategic and
functional contexts, to develop competence in advising the Board and
leading teams in administrative best practices, and in ensuring
compliance with external regulations and internal procedures.

sections.title: Name of Course/Module: Corporate Governance** **Course Code: GSM5117
sections.content:
**Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** This course covers both the
theoretical and practical perspectives of corporate governance, focusing
on what constitutes good governance, the need for Codes in various
countries, and issues of good governance.
**Name of Course/Module: Corporate Secretaryship** **Course Code:
GSM5119** **Credit Hours: 3** **Synopsis:** Discuss the main tasks as a
secretary to the Board. The module will highlight the essential
knowledge and skills required to perform secretarial duties in the
organization on a small, medium and large scale. It covers functionality
in a strategic context, advising the board, ensuring that laws and
regulations are followed, and effectively communicating the results of
the board internally and externally.
**Name of Course/Module: Corporate Social Responsibility** **Course

express forms of social and environmental responsibility in their
business practices. The course also takes an internal perspective by
considering practical reasoning in the context of managerial everyday
action in organizations, as managers and employees wrestle with issues
of ethical behavior.

Subject 2022, Taylor's University ranked 97 for Business and Management
Studies. It has climbed into the top 100 universities worldwide. Apart
from Malaysia, it became the best private business school in Southeast
Asia. Taylor's University is ranked 284th in the QS World Rankings 2024.

years. Taylor's Business School was founded in 1993. The business school
offers internationally recognized business degrees from Diplomas to
Bachelor, Master, and Doctorate (Ph.D.). It also offers prestigious
professional development programs. Bachelor of Business (Honors) at

sections.title: Taylor's University International Students Admissions
sections.content:
Students from all around the world planning to study in Malaysia can opt
for Taylor's University in Malaysia. International students must have
completed a course of study that meets the standards for the various
programs. All entrance criteria should be in line with the university's
regulations. International candidates and domestic students go through
the same process, with the exception that international applicants must
provide certain additional documents to study in Malaysia. The
university accepts applications through its online portal. Taylor's
University application requirements for international students are as
follows:
- Original academic transcripts
- A signed letter of acceptance
- Test to study in Malaysia- IELTS/TOEFL/MUET
- International reporting form
- CV
- Letter of recommendation
- Letter of scholarship or sponsorship (if required)
- Health certificate
- Copy of Passport

sections.title: Taylor's University Visa Process for International Students
sections.content:
International students are advised to apply for a Malaysian student visa
right after receiving the offer letter from Taylor's University. The
immigration department of Malaysia requires 6 to 8 weeks to issue a
student's visa. The international office of Taylor's University will
help international students submit all the required documents. Taylor's
University International Students' Document Requirements
- Signed offer letter (2 copies)
- Copy of Passport with a validity of more than 12 months
- 3 copies of Passport Biodata
- Original visa with 3 copies of visa approval letter
- Original academic transcripts
- Health or medical examination form
- Program fee receipts
- Flight ticket
- Driving license

sections.title: Taylor's University Malaysia
sections.content:
Taylor's University is Malaysia's top-ranked private university for
business studies, law, computer science, and engineering. It was
established as a college in 1969. Taylor's University Lakeside campus is
at Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. It is one of the best universities
in Malaysia for its QS ranking and good reputation worldwide. Based on
the QS World rankings, Taylor's University is often regarded as
Malaysia's top private university. Taylor's University got the
prestigious award of university college status in 2006. It was further
promoted to university status in 2010. Since 2010, Taylor University has
been a top-ranked private university ranking. Taylor's University is a
member of the Taylor's Education Group. It also includes British
University Vietnam, Taylor's College, Garden International School, Nexus
International School, Australian International School Malaysia, and
Taylor's International School.
Apart from Taylor's University, there are Taylor's International School
Kuala Lumpur and Puchong campus.
Taylor's University Lakeside Campus Address: 1, Jln Taylors, 47500
Subang Jaya, Selangor.
Status: Private University.
Established: Taylor College- 1969 and Taylor University 2006
Motto: Wisdom, Integrity, Excellence.
Website: <https://university.taylors.edu.my/en.html>

sections.title: Why Taylor's Is The Best Private University In Malaysia
sections.content:
According to the QS (Quacquarelli Symonds) World University Rankings by
Subject 2022, Taylor's University ranked 97 for Business and Management
Studies. It has climbed into the top 100 universities worldwide. Apart
from Malaysia, it became the best private business school in Southeast
Asia.
Taylor's University is ranked 284th in the QS World Rankings 2024. It
has been Southeast Asia's top private university for the past three
years. Taylor's Business School was founded in 1993. The business school
offers internationally recognized business degrees from Diplomas to
Bachelor, Master, and Doctorate (Ph.D.). It also offers prestigious
professional development programs. Bachelor of Business (Honors) at
Taylor's University is meant to provide students with an in-depth
understanding of fundamental business principles, processes, and
techniques, emphasizing marketing functions in worldwide organizations.
The university also has a 5-star rating in six other QS Stars University
Ratings categories.
The categories are as follows:
- Teaching
- Internalization
- Employability
- Facilities
- Inclusiveness
- Hospitality & Leisure Management.

sections.title: Taylor's University Lakeside Campus
sections.content:
A well-organized campus is essential for quality teaching and holistic
growth. Taylor University has a modern, practical design and
state-of-the-art facilities. It also has a 5.5-acre lake. Taylor's
lakeside campus represents Taylor's current devotion to quality teaching
and holistic growth outside the classroom.
Taylor\'s University Lakeside Campus
Taylor's University established its beautiful lakeside campus to
accommodate the ever-expanding number of students. There are also the
facilities of restaurants and shops situated in a commercial block. The
official accommodation for the students is in the U Residence.
Not just for the solution of the accommodation problem of the students,
the lakeside campus is also famous for its aesthetic beautification. It
was also awarded the Special Honor Award from the Institute of Landscape
Architects Malaysia in 2011. This is a very famous and honorable award
in Landscape design and planning. The Lakeside Campus was awarded in all
three Interior Design, Architecture, and Landscape building categories.

sections.title: Taylor's University International Students Admissions
sections.content:
Students from all around the world planning to study in Malaysia can opt
for Taylor's University in Malaysia. International students must have
completed a course of study that meets the standards for the various
programs. All entrance criteria should be in line with the university's
regulations. International candidates and domestic students go through
the same process, with the exception that international applicants must
provide certain additional documents to study in Malaysia. The
university accepts applications through its online portal.
Taylor's University application requirements for international students
are as follows:
- Original academic transcripts
- A signed letter of acceptance
- Test to study in Malaysia- IELTS/TOEFL/MUET
- International reporting form
- CV
- Letter of recommendation
- Letter of scholarship or sponsorship (if required)
- Health certificate
- Copy of Passport

sections.title: Taylor's University Visa Process for International Students
sections.content:
International students are advised to apply for a Malaysian student visa
right after receiving the offer letter from Taylor's University. The
immigration department of Malaysia requires 6 to 8 weeks to issue a
student's visa. The international office of Taylor's University will
help international students submit all the required documents.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
UCSI University, located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, is a distinguished
institution of higher education known for its commitment to academic
excellence, innovative teaching approaches, and comprehensive student
development. UCSI University has played a pivotal role in shaping the
educational landscape of Malaysia and the broader region, providing a
dynamic learning environment that fosters intellectual growth,
creativity, and global citizenship.

sections.title: History of UCSI University
sections.content:
UCSI University traces its roots back to 1986 when it was established as
the Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators (ICSA)
Malaysia. Initially offering professional business administration and
management courses, the institution quickly gained recognition for its
high-quality education and industry relevance.
In 2003, ICSA Malaysia was granted university college status by the
Malaysian government, marking a significant milestone in its evolution.
With this newfound status, the institution expanded its academic
offerings to include undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various
disciplines, ranging from engineering and architecture to health
sciences and liberal arts.
Driven to become a leading global university, UCSI University continued
to innovate and grow. In 2008, it achieved full university status,
officially becoming UCSI University. This transformation signified a
commitment to providing a comprehensive and diverse educational
experience that prepares students for success in a rapidly changing
world.
Over the years, UCSI University has garnered numerous accolades and
achievements, cementing its reputation as a premier institution of
higher learning in Malaysia. It has consistently been ranked among the
top universities in the country and has received accreditation and
recognition from reputable international bodies and professional
organizations.
Today, UCSI University stands as a beacon of excellence in Malaysian
higher education, attracting students from across the globe seeking a
world-class academic experience. With its focus on innovation, research,
and holistic student development, UCSI University continues to push
boundaries and set new standards for educational excellence in Malaysia
and beyond.

sections.title: UCSI University Ranking 2025
sections.content:
In the QS World University Rankings by Subject, UCSI University has been
recognized for its excellence in several fields. In the QS World
University Rankings by Subject 2022, UCSI University was ranked among
the top universities globally in Hospitality & Leisure Management,
showcasing its strength in this specialized area of study.
Furthermore, in national rankings conducted by Malaysian authorities and
educational organizations, UCSI University has consistently been listed
among the top universities in Malaysia. These rankings take into account
factors such as academic reputation, research output, faculty
qualifications, student satisfaction, and the employability of
graduates.

It is ranked #265 in the QS World University Rankings 2025.
Campus Address: No.1, UCSI Heights, Jalan Puncak Menara Gading, Taman
Connaught, 56000 Cheras, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Status: Private University
Established: UCSI University was established in 1986.
Motto: Develop global citizens, inspire future leaders, and provide a
holistic education.

sections.title: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
sections.content:
University of Putra Malaysia (Malay: Universiti Putra Malaysia),
abbreviated as UPM, is a Malaysian public research university located in
Serdang, Selangor. Formerly, it was named Universiti Pertanian Malaysia
(Agricultural University of Malaysia), focusing on agricultural sciences
and related fields. Since the 1990s, the fields of study have expanded
to include human ecology, languages, architecture, medicine, computer
science, and biotechnology. Currently, there are 15 faculties, 11
institutes, and 2 schools covering these as well as agriculture,
forestry, veterinary medicine, economics, engineering, sciences, and
education.

sections.title: Establishment of Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
sections.content:
Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) was first established on 21st May 1931
by John Scott, an administrative officer of the Straits Settlements.
Then named the School of Agriculture, only two kinds of programs were
offered: a three-year diploma programme and a one-year certificate
course. The School was then renamed the College of Agriculture Malaya by
Sir Edward Gent, the Governor of the Malayan Union, on 23rd June 1947. A
year later, it was proposed that the college be upgraded to a
university, but the declaration of an Emergency later that year put the
plan on hold. Nevertheless, the role of the college began to become more
significant, in line with the rapid growth of the country's agricultural
sector, leading to the then Prime Minister, Tun Abdul Razak Hussein,
envisioning the establishment of an agricultural university when
officiating extensions to the college structure in 1969.
This vision eventually came to fruition when Universiti Pertanian
Malaysia was founded in 1973. This borderless campus was reflected in
the name change from Universiti Pertanian Malaysia to Universiti Putra
Malaysia in 1997, by the then Prime Minister Dato' Seri Dr. Mahathir
Mohamad. Today, UPM is on its way to becoming a university of
international repute, boasting the highest percentage of academic staff
with PhD qualifications among local universities in Malaysia, and
students from over 70 countries around the world. For more information
about Universiti Putra Malaysia, visit this website:

sections.title: UPM Recognition
sections.content:
UPM has been recognized as a research university since 2006, one of five
in Malaysia. In 2010, the Malaysian Qualifications Agency awarded UPM
self-accreditation status to simplify the procedure of accrediting
academic programs and strengthen its Internal Quality Assurance (IQA)
system so that it could compete with local universities.
Location and Address: Jalan Universiti 1, 43400 Serdang, Selangor,
Malaysia. Status: Public Research University. Established: 29 October
1971. Motto: With Knowledge We Serve. Specialty: Agricultural Science
and related fields. Website: upm.edu.my

sections.title: DOCTORAL DEGREE PROGRAMME (PhD)
sections.content:
The applicant shall possess: A master's degree in the field or related
fields accepted by the UPM Senate; or Other qualifications equivalent to
a master's degree recognised by the Government of Malaysia (Malaysia
Qualification Agency); or Candidates without a related qualification in
the field/s or working experience in the relevant fields must undergo
appropriate prerequisite courses determined by the
Faculty/School/Institute. A Bachelor's degree with the following
conditions: i) A Bachelor's degree in the field or related fields with a
first-class or its equivalent. ii) Undergo internal assessment by the
Faculty/School/Institute.; AND iii) Any other requirement of the
Faculty/School/Institute Note: For the applicant admitted from a
Bachelor's degree to a PhD, the applicant shall not be awarded a
Master's Degree if the applicant fails their viva voce. An applicant who
is in the final semester of the final year of his master's study
programme may be considered for provisional admission, subject to his
current CGPA or its equivalent satisfying the Doctoral Degree programme
admission requirements. Fulfill other requirements specified by the
Faculty/School/Institute for each programme.

sections.title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEST MINIMUM ACCEPTABLE SCORE
sections.content:
IELTS band 5.5 and above; or TOEFL TOEFL iBT score of 60 and above; or
Pearson PTE Score of 43 and above; or Cambridge Assessment Test
Cambridge English (CAE/CPE/Linguaskill) Score 154 and above MUET MUET
band 3 and above; or ELS UPM CIEP level 107 and above CIEP is available
on campus at UPM or online. Learn more.
NOTE: IELTS INDICATOR, APTIS, DUOLINGO, AND TOEFL ITP are not acceptable
to meet the English Language requirement. The validity period of the
English Language Proficiency score should not be more than five years.

sections.title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE EXEMPTION
sections.content:
Exemption of the English Language requirement can be given for: -- An
international applicant studying at an international school where
English is the language of instruction. An international applicant from
a native English-speaking country. An international applicant from a
non-native English-speaking country where English is an official
language. If your application is successful, we will make you a full
offer. However, you may receive a provisional offer if you apply without
English language proficiency and are successful.

sections.title: Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM)
sections.content:
Universiti Utara Malaysia is a public management university in Malaysia.
It is situated in the Sintok, Kedah area. It also has a branch campus in
Kuala Lumpur. Universiti Utara Malaysia is commonly known as UUM or
University Utara Malaysia. It has a specialized program in Management
education in the country. The main vision of this university is to
promote and develop management education in the country. UUM also acts
as a catalyst for socio-economic development in the northern region of
Peninsular Malaysia.

UUM has become one of the best public research-based universities in
Malaysia for offering programs in the area of management, accounting,
economics, information technology, public administration, human resource
management, entrepreneurship, finance and banking, law, marketing,
management of technology, communication, social work, multimedia,
education, decision science, international affairs, business management,
tourism, administration, development management, logistics and
transportation, hospitality, risk and insurance management, media
technology, agribusiness management science, business mathematics,
industrial statistics, and counseling.

sections.title: Why will UUM be the best choice for you?

Universiti Utara Malaysia is one of the five public universities in
Malaysia dedicated to business and management education. This university
has a huge impact on Business education in society.
In management, UUM's academic programs are especially geared toward
providing a broad spectrum of academic knowledge and intellectual
skills.
The university contributes to communities' social, economic, and
intellectual development beyond the campus. It also has a very positive
role in the nation's socio-economic development. University Utara
Malaysia provides
- Quality teaching
- Conducting extensive research
- Promoting a culture of scholarly publications
Besides its core and basic programs and services, they also play a cruel
role in engaging the surrounding local communities in community-based
projects---the university collaboration with other government agencies
and existing related private sectors in developing or strengthening
community-university partnerships.

sections.title: University Utara Malaysia Admissions for International Students
sections.content:
University Utara Malaysia cordially welcomes international students from
all over the world. To be admitted to the University of Utara Malaysia
for higher education, international students must have a certificate
demonstrating successful completion of high school. They also need to
meet the English language standards.
The documents required to submit at the time of application for
International students listed below:
- The academic record of a school or college recognized by the Senate
 of the university
- English proficiency proof
- Entrance exam as per the course
- Resume
- Work experience
- Financial certificate
- Health certificate
- Passport

sections.title: Visa Processing for the International Students
sections.content:
After receiving the University of Utara Malaysia offer letter,
international students can apply for a Malaysian student visa. The
student's visa is issued by Malaysia's immigration department, which
takes at least two months.
The mandatory requirements for visa application to study in Malaysia
are:
- Accepted offer letter from the university
- Original academic transcripts
- One passport-size photograph
- Passport with a validity of at least 12 months
- Three copies of passport biodata
- Original visa with three copies of visa approval letter
- Health declaration form
- Program fee receipts
- Flight ticket
- Driving license

sections.title: University College of Aviation Malaysia (UNiCAM)
sections.content:
The University College of Aviation Malaysia (UniCAM) is a premier
institution dedicated to providing high-quality education and training
in the field of aviation. UniCAM offers a comprehensive range of
programs designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills
required to excel in various aviation careers like Nilai University. The
institution prides itself on its state-of-the-art facilities,
experienced faculty, and strong industry connections, making it a
preferred choice for aspiring aviation professionals.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
UniCAM was established to become a leading center of excellence in
aviation education. Since its inception, the university has focused on
developing a curriculum integrating theoretical knowledge and practical
experience. Over the years, UniCAM has expanded its program offerings
and facilities to meet the evolving needs of the aviation industry. The
institution has also forged partnerships with key players in the
aviation sector, enhancing its ability to provide students with
real-world insights and opportunities.

sections.title: Facilities and Resources
sections.content:
UniCAM is equipped with modern facilities that support a conducive
learning environment. The university boasts advanced simulators,
well-equipped laboratories, and a fleet of training aircraft to provide
students with practical training. Additionally, UniCAM has a dedicated
career services department that assists students in securing internships
and job placements in the aviation industry.

sections.title: Faculty and Staff
sections.content:
The faculty at UniCAM comprises experienced professionals and academics
with extensive backgrounds in aviation. They bring a wealth of knowledge
and industry experience to the classroom, ensuring that students receive
high-quality education and mentorship. The university also engages
industry experts as guest lecturers to provide students with current
industry perspectives and trends.

sections.title: Industry Partnerships and Collaborations
sections.content:
UniCAM has established strong partnerships with various airlines,
aviation organizations, and regulatory bodies. These collaborations
enable the university to offer students practical training
opportunities, industry visits, and exposure to the latest developments
in aviation. The partnerships also facilitate research and development
initiatives that contribute to the advancement of the aviation sector.

sections.title: Student Life and Extracurricular Activities
sections.content:
UniCAM offers a vibrant campus life with numerous extracurricular
activities and student organizations. Students have the opportunity to
participate in aviation clubs, sports, and community service activities,
which enhance their overall educational experience. The university also
hosts seminars, workshops, and conferences to keep students informed
about industry trends and developments.

## Entry Requirements for Foundation Programmes
Medicine: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and obtain a
general pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or
equivalent with a Grade B in Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology,
and one other subject, Grade C in English, and one other subject.
Business: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and obtain a
general pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or
equivalent with min Grade C in 5 subjects including Mathematics and
English.
Science & Technology / Science: Students must complete 11 years of
schooling and obtain a general pass in their Secondary School
Certificate, O-levels or equivalent with min Grade C in 5 subjects
including Mathematics and one Science subject.
Information Technology: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and
obtain a general pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or
equivalent with min Grade C in 5 subjects including Mathematics.

## Entry Requirements for Diploma Programmes
Aircraft Engineering: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and
obtain a general pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or
equivalent with min Grade C in Mathematics, English, one
science/vocational/technical subject and 3 other subjects. IELTS 5.0 or
equivalent.
Nursing/Pharmacy: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and
obtain a general pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or
equivalent with min Grade C in Mathematics, English, one science subject
(Chemistry or Biology) and 2 other subjects. IELTS 5.00 or equivalent.
Other: Students must complete 11 years of schooling and obtain a general
pass in their Secondary School Certificate, O-levels or equivalent with
min Grade C in Mathematics, English, one science/vocational/technical
subject and 2 other subjects. IELTS 5.0 or equivalent.

## Entry Requirements for Bachelor Programmes
Business & Management: Students must complete 12 years of schooling and
obtain a general pass in their High School Certificate, A-levels or
equivalent with min Grade C (60%) in any 2 subjects and pass (50%) in
Mathematics and English in their Secondary School or O-level. IELTS 5.5
or equivalent.
Information Technology: Students must complete 12 years of schooling and
obtain a general pass in their High School Certificate, A-levels or
equivalent with a Grade C (60%) in any 2 subjects and a Grade C (60%) in
Mathematics in their Secondary School or O-level. IELTS 5.0 or
equivalent.
Engineering and Engineering Technology: Students must complete 12 years
of schooling and obtain a general pass in their High School Certificate,
A-levels or equivalent with min Grade C (60%) in Mathematics and one of
the Science subjects (such as Physics, Chemistry or Biology -- depending
on the programme) IELTS 5.0 or equivalent.
Medicine and Allied Health Science: Students must complete 12 years of
schooling and obtain a general pass in their High School Certificate,
A-levels or equivalent with min Grade B (85%) in Chemistry, Biology,
Physics or Mathematics. IELTS 6.0 or equivalent.
