sections.title: UniKL
sections.content:
University Kuala Lumpur is one of the renowned semi-government
universities in Malaysia. University Kuala Lumpur, known as UniKL, is
situated in Malaysia's capital city. UniKL is a famous engineering and
technology university and is a multi-campus private university. This
University has worldwide fame and achievement for offering dynamic
programs and facilities for local and international students. UniKL
tries to provide huge facilities for international students. University
Kuala Lumpur offers the International Student Exchange Mobility Program
(ISEM) to build a global community and culture of international
students. ISEM helps students in obtaining knowledge about diverse
cultures. It also enhances the confidence of students to work globally.
Therefore, international students from Asia and the Middle East prefer
to join UniKL immensely.

sections.title: UniKL Establishment
sections.content:
University Kuala Lumpur (UniKL) was founded on 20 August 2002. It is
possessed by Majlis Amanah Rakyat, an agency governed by the Ministry of
Rural and Regional Development.

sections.title: UniKL Recognition
sections.content:
UniKL is a well-established and recognized university by the Ministry of
Higher Education of Malaysia (Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi).

sections.title: University Kuala Lumpur (UniKL Ranking)
sections.content:
University Kuala Lumpur is one of the reputed semi-government
universities in Malaysia. UniKL ranked between 1001 and 1200 in Qs World
University Rankings and Asian University Rankings in 2022, and it ranks
401 to 500 in Asia University Rankings 2022.

sections.title: Why is UniKL the Best?
sections.content:
University Kuala Lumpur provides great excellent ages for both local and
international students. After graduation, international students can
nourish themselves to move on to global worlds with versatile qualities.
The following factors might enhance UniKL's reputation globally:
Firstly, all the University's programs are well-architected and designed
for international students. This University serves almost 140 programs
for both local and international students, including foundation,
diploma, bachelor, master's, and doctor of philosophy (Ph.D.). Students
can choose subjects relevant to their careers and background. UniKL
University tries to make students more skilled by providing technical
support.
Secondly, the lecturers and staff are qualified enough to educate
students adequately. The entire environment of this University is
exceptionally student-friendly. Students can overcome any challenging
situations with the help of their lecturers, coordinators, and
supervisors. Even the University conducts a student counseling program,
and students get counseling services for free cost.
Thirdly, all the programs offered by UniKL are affordable for national
and international students for their low tuition fee structure.
Moreover, students can pay fees for each semester or early.
Furthermore, UniKL provides affordable accommodation and free-library
facilities for students. Accommodation services are available at
reasonable rates. The library facility is essential for enriching
students' knowledge, and UniKL has this outstanding facility. Moreover,
UniKL also gives importance to co-curricular activities and provides
students with sports and recreational facilities.

sections.title: UniKL Campus
sections.content:
UniKL has around 12 campuses across Malaysia. All campuses are situated
in convenient places for transportation. Every campus is
student-friendly in infrastructure. Hence, many students describe campus
life as 'Feels Like Home.

sections.title: UniKL Programs
sections.content:
UniKL University provides diverse courses; many faculties provide almost
140 programs. The University offers foundation, bachelor's, diploma,
master's, doctoral, and certificate programs in technology, management,
engineering, and science. UniKL also maintains collaborations with
worldwide universities. All the programs are well-planned, and it helps
to establish talented students. This University tries to provide equal
facilities for both local and international students.

sections.title: University Malaysia Kelantan (UMK)
sections.content:
University Malaysia Kelantan is a young public university in Malaysia.
It was established in 2006 by Prime Minister, Y.A.B. Tun Abdullah Ahmad
Badawi to provide quality education in Malaysia. However, UMK started to
enroll students in 2007. University Malaysia Kelantan emphasizes the
following fields of study: heritage and agro-based industry,
entrepreneurship and business creative technology, and earth science.
The UMK offers graduate and post-graduate programs for local and
international students in multiple disciplines. Students have enormous
opportunities to focus on practical skills through the courses to
complete their graduate degrees successfully.
Around 90 percent of graduate students get involved in industry work.
The University collaborates with industrial and academic
entrepreneurship, and students can contribute to the entrepreneurial
society. The University strongly emphasizes entrepreneurship values that
contribute to the total income of around RM500,000. University Malaysia
Kelantan has a strong relationship with global universities with an
excellent reputation for entrepreneurship education, such as Babson
College in the United States of America. UMK has strong relations with
several universities from ASEAN, the Middle East, and European
countries. Students have a wide range of facilities including computer
laboratories, a cafeteria, a library, computers, accommodation, and
sports facilities. They also have the opportunity to take part in social
clubs and associations.

sections.title: Why UMK is the Best For Study?
sections.content:
Undoubtedly, the University of Malaysia Kelantan is the best university
in Malaysia. Firstly, the university has organized various programs to
develop their employability. All of the programs build world-class
entrepreneurs so that they can contribute to the community.
Secondly, the University of Malaysia Kelantan offers scholarship
programs for students. UMK offers 83% of scholarships for its students
from PTPTN, KWSP, MARA, and JAKOA.
Thirdly, students have an opportunity to learn entrepreneurship skills
so that they can use their knowledge when they enter the corporate
world.
Fourthly, students have hostel facilities on three campuses, including
the library, which offers modern databases and equipment.
Fifthly, the university ensures an environment for students to be
involved with clubs, business malls, and associations.
Finally, the University of Malaysia Kelantan ensures world-class
education opportunities for students. Almost half of the lecturers of
the university hold a PhD degree.

sections.content:
University Malaysia Pahang (UMP) is a World-Class Technological Public
University in Malaysia. UMP has become the best young technical
university in Malaysia for offering many engineering programs such as
Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
(Automotive), Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering,
Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering (Electronics),
Electrical Engineering (Power System), and so more. In addition, UMP
offers dual degree programs; for example, Engineering Dual Degree with
HSKA German and Business Engineering with HSRT German. The former name
of the University Malaysia Pahang (UMP) was Kolej Universiti
Kejuruteraan dan Teknologi Malaysia.
UMP is located on the east coast in the industrial belt in the
peninsular, surrounded by rainforests, beaches, and natural
biodiversity. The natural atmosphere made this university a fantastic
spot for education. UMP's engineering and technology departments have
managed to rank 751-800 QS World University Ranking 2021. The Malaysian
government established this public university on 16 February 2002. UMP
has received many international awards for training, engineering, and
technical achievements in a short time.

sections.title: Advantages of Study at University Malaysia Pahang (UMP)
sections.content:
Scholarship: UMP Foundation provides scholarships to help students pay
their tuition fees. These scholarships are available for national and
international students who obtained good results in their previous
studies and maintain good results at UMP. These scholarships are
allocated for bachelor's and master's students.
Educational Facilities: UMP focuses on research, innovation, technical,
engineering, and business administration programs. UMP covers all the
educational facilities required for these programs. From classrooms to
reasonable practices. Such as:
Library The UMP Library is filled with a collection of best-standardized
books necessary for diploma, bachelor's, master's, and PhD students.
Students and lecturers can borrow books from this library for a certain
time without paying any money.
Laboratory University Malaysia Pahang owns the finest laboratory that
facilitates students to learn more.UMP believes in innovation; students
can do their experiments in these laboratories. They are taught many
practical things under the supervision of the best teachers.
Practical Practices UMP is associated with many government projects of
the education ministry. Hence, students can work practically in the
technological and engineering industries. This practical training makes
the students confident and increases their capability.
Job Opportunities UMP graduates are very demandable in engineering,
technological, and administrative job sectors worldwide. In 2012, 79% of
graduate students got a job within six months. As the students are
competent in their departments and enriched with practical knowledge,
they find a job quickly.
Natural Beauty UPM is located in a place with mesmerizing natural
biodiversity. Students can enjoy the beach, rainforest, sea, and lakes
from the university campus area. Many species of birds, insects, and
animals are often seen here. These scenarios amaze students' minds with
peace and joy.

sections.title: Why University Malaysia Pahang is the best?
sections.content:
It's the best choice for higher study to complete graduation and
post-graduation, enhancing the capabilities to build a career in
engineering with practical knowledge. The university aims to achieve
excellent consulting and training services in technology, creating
research collaboration internationally. The university has contributed
to developing the industries by supporting research to create and
discover new technology fields. It's a university that the MyMoHES
database of the Ministry of Higher Education has given a star.
The campus provides a research laboratory, student center, enterprise
and innovation center, cafeteria, basketball courts, and research and
development center for the students. The sports complex is a world-class
complex on the largest floor for several sporting events. The university
focuses on basketball. Students can participate in sports activities.
The university has a library which is big enough. It's a well-equipped
and computerized library with the latest books, journals, and e-books.
Students have the chance to get a secure job just within six months of
graduation.
Firstly, the University of Malaysia Pahang offers a wide variety of
student programs, including accredited technical education and
engineering programs. Secondly, The university offers a wireless
connection to the internet as it's facilitated with the latest ICT
system so that the students have an opportunity for electronic-based and
e-learning with e-management activities.
Thirdly, you can study with brilliant and talented students because the
university is very selective in enrolling students. They follow a
particular admission policy for entrance admission, and it's recognized
as one of the most selective institutions in Malaysia.
Fourthly, students can enjoy the facility of nonacademic services like
financial aid, sports, library, and administrative services.
Fifthly, the university offers scholarships for students. Students with
good results and academic scores can apply for scholarship programs the
university offers if they deserve it. International students can grab
this opportunity. Postgraduates and postgraduates apply for scholarships
also.

sections.title: Student facilities
sections.content:
Library The library of the University Malaysia Pahang is a center of
excellence for students. The library ensures good services for the
students. The authority upgrades the library system, allowing learning
to learn soft skills and new things. The library provides a manual
guidebook and thesis for the students, and with more than practical
knowledge.
Sports Complex University Malaysia Pahang provides a large sports
complex for students. The sports complex comprises a large floor. The
sporting events of public universities are arranged in the sports
complex. The sports complex focuses on the opportunity of playing
basketball with students.
Job opportunities University Malaysia Pahang students get a job after
competing in their studies. The university focuses on building
world-class graduates who can create a better future. In most cases,
students get jobs after six months of completing their studies.
Internet facility Students can access the internet at any time when they
are on campus. The university covers a WiFi facility to connect
internet.
Labs The university has a digital language lab that focuses on learning
using communication tools. The lab was developed to engage students in
communicative activities, and students can be proficient in speaking
with cultural norms.
Hostels The university provides a hostel for students. A lively
environment surrounds the hostels, and students can live and discuss
their lives for their studies. The hostel management is very careful
about creating living opportunities for the students. Around 700
students live on the hostel premises.

sections.title: Dual programs
sections.content:
University Malaysia Pahang offers a dual program with a Bachelor of
Automotive Engineering with honors. It was developed by the Karlsruhe
University of Applied Sciences, Germany. The program covers nine
semesters to help students learn automotive engineering knowledge.
Students have a chance to learn from the faculties of the University
Malaysia Pahang and the flying faculties. After completing the program,
students get jobs, including working in German companies.
University Malaysia Pahang offers another dual program: a Bachelor of
Electrical Engineering with honors. It's a program with the Karlsruhe
University of Applied Sciences. Along with electrical and electronics
engineering fundamentals, students can learn English communication.
Students have to complete a six-month thesis module.
The university offers another dual program, a Bachelor of Mechatronics
Engineering, with honors. It's a program between this university and the
HsKA university, and the program is a collaboration with experts in
Germany. While they complete the program, they will get a certificate
from HsKA and UMP.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
**University Technology Malaysia (UTM): Courses, Tuition Fees &
Admission Process**
University Technology Malaysia (UTM) is a research-based university for
engineering, science, and technology. It is situated in 3 locations
Johor Baru, Kuala Lumpur and Pagoh. According to QS University rankings,
the esteemed Malaysian public university known as the University of
Technology Malaysia (Universiti Teknologi Malaysia in Malay), or UTM, is
rated 153 in the world.
UTM has been the country's main supplier of technical and professional
workers for regional businesses, governmental organizations, and
international corporations since its founding as a technical school in
1904 and its transformation into a full-fledged university in 1972. UTM
strategically meets both academic and research demands with its two
campuses. Located in the center of Kuala Lumpur, the UTM Kuala Lumpur
Campus provides a bustling urban atmosphere. The main campus, meanwhile,
is situated in the Iskandar Malaysia area, a prosperous economic
corridor in Johor, in the southern portion of Peninsular Malaysia, which
offers a favorable setting for development and innovation.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
sections.content:
1. Where is UTM situated? Ans: They have 2 campuses, one in Johor Baru
 and the other in Kuala Lumpur. UTM main campus is in Johor Baru,
 which is 300 kilometers from Kuala Lumpur.
2. What are the admission requirements for Undergraduate International
 Students? Ans: Mentioned on our website in detail.
3. What kind of accommodation facilities do you have for single and/or
 married students? Ans: 11 residential colleges can accommodate about
 17,000 students. Married house/ apartment, although more limited in
 number, are available for postgraduate students who wish to bring
 along their family.
4. How many semesters/intakes does UTM have? Ans: Two semesters in a
 year.
5. How can I know that I have been accepted to UTM? Ans: Every online
 application will be processed within 5 working days for evaluation,
 and only successful applicants will be offered to study at UTM. All
 sucessful applicant will receive the offer letter through email.
6. How much processing fee should I pay for an application? How can I
 pay? Ans: The application fee is RM80.00 per application for
 Malaysian students and RM450.00 for International students. It
 should be paid using FPX, Credit/Debit card, and Flywire before
 submitting your application.
7. Do I have to attend all the lectures? Ans: Students must attend at
 least 80% of the lecture meetings. This is essential to ensure
 students have received adequate knowledge and exposures, before
 sitting for the final exam. In case of non-compliance with this
 attendance requirement, students will be barred from sitting in the
 final examination.
8. International student apply weekend class? Ans: Yes, if you have the
 working pass for categories 1 and 2.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
sections.content:
1. What are the collaborations between Xiamen University Malaysia and
 partner universities?
A: Generally, there are two types of collaborations:
Postgraduate Study Progression Pathways A progression pathway indicates
a collaboration with a partner university that defines the admission
criteria to facilitate students' academic progress towards a
postgraduate degree. Through this simplified pathway, students from our
campus may progress into a postgraduate degree at the esteemed
institution with certain privileges, such as a tuition fee discount or
an exemption on the English language proficiency requirement.
Study Abroad
This framework aims to provide opportunities for undergraduate students
to broaden their academic experiences through student mobility. Under
this framework, students will be able to study abroad for a semester or
an academic year, and the majors are usually not subject-specific.
Note: Please keep in mind that not all partner universities provide
postgraduate study progression pathways and study abroad, as some
discussions with partner universities are still ongoing.
2. What are the requirements needed to apply for the postgraduate
 degree/study abroad programme at our partner university? A:
 Generally, most postgraduate degree/study abroad programmes require
 students to have an undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or above and to meet
 the requirement for English language proficiency.
3. What documents are needed to apply for the postgraduate degree/study
 abroad programme at our partner university? A: Normally, students
 will apply for a postgraduate degree / study abroad programme with
 their latest official result slip and other documents depending on
 the requirements of the university (e.g., proof of English language
 proficiency, personal statement, recommendation letter, passport
 profile, etc.).
4. How do I apply if I am interested in a postgraduate degree / study
 abroad programme at our partner university? A: Different partner
 universities have different application methods. Some partner
 universities require students to apply through the Global Engagement
 and Partnerships Office, and some partner universities require
 students to directly apply through the online portal. Hence, should
 you be interested in applying to any of the programmes, you may
 contact the Global Engagement and Partnerships Office, and they can
 guide you further.
